# vendor/

`mediabunny.min.mjs` is [Mediabunny](https://github.com/Vanilagy/mediabunny) 1.62.1, unmodified, copied from the npm
package's `dist/bundles/mediabunny.min.mjs`. It is licensed under the Mozilla Public License 2.0 (`MEDIABUNNY-LICENSE.txt`);
the source is available at the link above. It is loaded only by `pro-engine.js`, the optional WebCodecs recording engine.

To update: `cd bench && npm install mediabunny@<version>`, copy the bundle over, re-run `node --test tests/pro-engine.test.js`.
